items.name: Cloak of Resistance +3
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Belt of Mighty Constitution +4
items.description: This belt’s golden buckle depicts a bear’s head. The belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Constitution of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn.

items.name: Celestial Aegis
items.description: Crafted from mysterious Skymetal, the Celestial Aegis is an advanced piece of armor reflecting the cutting-edge engineering of Unity, a demigod-like AI within the technological landscapes of Numeria. Adorned with circuits that shimmer in iridescent blue, this armor integrates cybernetics seamlessly, enhancing Ophelia's capability as a gargoyle enforcer.
